FCOC Vendors Import Template Notes

Preferred columns:
Business Name
Contact Person
Email
Phone
Website
Business Description
Preferred Contact Method
Admit to This Event?
Featured?
Visible to Members?
Action Type
Signup URL
Booth Location
Event Note
Display Order

Required:
- Business Name

Field-by-field notes:
- Business Name (required, text): The vendor's business name. Required. Maps to the canonical Vendor directory's business_name.
- Contact Person (optional, text): The vendor's primary contact person.
- Email (optional, email): Vendor contact email.
- Phone (optional, phone): Vendor contact phone.
- Website (optional, url): Vendor website, if any.
- Business Description (optional, text): Short description shown on the vendor's public listing.
- Preferred Contact Method (optional, enum): One of: email, phone, text, in_app.
- Admit to This Event? (optional, boolean_yes_no): Not yet executable (Stage 5B). Intended to drive the governed admission action for this Event, not a stored column.
- Featured? (optional, boolean_yes_no): Per-event display flag. Maps to event_vendors.is_featured.
- Visible to Members? (optional, boolean_yes_no): Per-event display flag. Maps to event_vendors.is_visible_to_members.
- Action Type (optional, enum): One of: service_request, external_signup, info_only. Maps to event_vendors.action_type.
- Signup URL (optional, url): Required only when Action Type is external_signup. Maps to event_vendors.signup_url.
- Booth Location (optional, text): Per-event booth/site location. Maps to the governed event_vendors.booth_location field.
- Event Note (optional, text): Per-event admin note. Maps to event_vendors.event_note.
- Display Order (optional, integer): Per-event display order. Maps to event_vendors.display_order (default 100 if blank).

The sample template can be used as the model for either XLSX or CSV imports.
